name: feeling
description: Feeling the Machine: study administration and the public site at feelingthemachine.com.

scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run test

_check_comment: The one gate. CI runs `npm ci && npm run check`, then deploys `site/` from the same job. There is no build: `site/` is served as it is in the repo, so the bytes checked are the bytes deployed. WHAT IT CANNOT SEE: the shell scripts in scripts/ (no linter reads them), what Cloudflare actually serves (curl it), and the encrypted vault, which by design never touches this repo.
